assets.caption: Exhibit 4-30: Grade-Mounted or Elevated Centrifugal Compressor: Open-Sided Structure
assets.notes: Two elevation-section views of a centrifugal compressor in an open-sided structure with a roof. Upper view: grade-mounted compressor on a pedestal/foundation with arched opening below; truck-mounted mobile handling equipment (crane/boom) at left and a permanent handling beam (optional) spanning the underside of the roof above the compressor. Annotations: ROOF, MOBILE HANDLING EQUIPMENT, PERMANENT HANDLING (OPTIONAL); circled levels I (grade-mounted) and II. Lower view: elevated multicompressor arrangement with two compressors at level I on an elevated deck supported by piers with arched openings beneath; permanent handling (optional) hoist with load at right; circled levels I (elevated deck) and II (grade). Legend at bottom: circled I = GRADE MOUNTED, circled II = ELEVATED. Caption block at upper right reads EXHIBIT 4-30 / Grade-Mounted or Elevated Centrifugal Compressor: Open-Sided Structure.
